pages.title: Mark the working area
pages.text: Place an Automation Field controller. Lay a connected area of Field Markers beside it at the controller’s base height.$(br2)Markers must sit under the columns where the $(thing)nodes$() will be. Fill the area rather than marking only its outline. Set the height in the controller’s hologram to reach the nodes, and enable the outline display to check coverage.

pages.title: Connect two chests
pages.text: $(li)Put an $(item)Output Item Node$() on the source chest.$(li)Put an $(item)Input Item Node$() on the destination chest.$(li)Set matching item filters on both nodes.$(li)Supply the controller with both fluxes.$(br2)An Output Node takes items out of its chest; an Input Node puts items into its chest.

pages.title: Start small
pages.text: Set the Output Node’s batch size to 1 for your first transfer. Put matching items in the source and leave room in the destination.$(br2)The default Whitelist mode needs samples on both nodes. An empty whitelist allows nothing; an empty blacklist allows everything.$(br2)Enable the outline display to check coverage. Mark the node columns even when they sit beside, rather than above, the chests.
